description: Wait for the person's next message in the OpenTakeoff Assistant window (after assistant_open). Returns status "message" with their text — do what they ask (with the other tools), reply with assistant_say, then call assistant_listen again. Status "timeout" = nothing typed yet: call assistant_listen again right away, saying nothing to the person. Status "sleep" = 10 quiet minutes: stop listening and tell the person in one line to say "listen" when they want you back (then call assistant_open, which reconnects without a new code).

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait (default 45, max 240). Keep it under your client's tool timeout.

name: assistant_listen

idle_s.description: Seconds since the person last wrote

message.description: What the person typed (several messages joined), or null

status.description: message = the person wrote; timeout = call again; sleep = stop, they are away
